title: Logo build
description: A logo sting: four coloured dots fly in on curved paths with comet trails, land, and morph into a mark (petals, pinwheel, stacked bars or a 2×2 kit of shapes); the mark turns and locks with a small settle, then moves aside as the wordmark rises letter by letter, with an optional tagline. The marks are original geometric marks, not anyone's logo. Opaque; for intros, outros and brand bumpers.

name.description: The wordmark (empty: the mark alone, staying centred).

tagline.description: A small line under the wordmark (empty: none).

mark.description: The mark the dots become: four petals round a centre, a pinwheel of quarter discs, four stacked bars, or a 2×2 kit of circle, square, quarter disc and pill.

colors.description: The four pieces' colours as #rrggbb (empty: the palette's accent, secondary, ink and muted).

weight.description: Wordmark weight for sans and mono.
